baseline.selection: A purposive catalogue of 12 English state-funded primary schools with a documented stopped closure or merger proposal, 2019-2026, alongside four selected closure comparisons. These cases are not a national census, a representative sample or a matched control group. They cannot estimate a survival rate or the effectiveness of a campaign tactic.

definitions.legal_advice_or_representation: Attributed school/diocese-side advice being taken/sought or explicit lawyer representation before historical favourable outcome. Advice sought does not prove receipt or lawyer retention.
definitions.explicit_lawyer: Source explicitly identifies lawyers, solicitors or barrister acting for school/supporting diocese before favourable outcome.
definitions.unknown: Not established in sources inspected. Never means no lawyers.
definitions.outcome_stage: Stage at reprieve from original catalogue, not uniformly verified named pre-consultation entry.
definitions.saved: Particular proposal stopped or successor provision continued; no guarantee of permanent rescue.
definitions.fundraising_only: Request for legal donations, without verified actual advice/retention/spending.

search_log.method: Targeted case-specific public searches; not a systematic national search. Full results used as discovery leads, not automatically as verified claims.
queries: St George Langton Matravers school closure lawyer solicitor
Wroxall school closure solicitor lawyer legal advice
St George Langton Matravers solicitor closure
St John the Divine lawyer closure
search_log.exclusions: Irrelevant solicitor directories/property listings excluded. Mere general legal duties, decision-maker advice, donor names, and unverified campaign allegations not used as involvement evidence. No schools added because legal evidence was easier to find.

limitations: Selected favourable cases; no national survival or lawyer effectiveness estimate.
Five unknowns cannot be classified as saved without lawyers.
Three advice-only cases do not independently establish professional credentials; two say advice sought.
Shared programmes, episodes and representation are not independent trials.
Historic endpoint dates retained; no new full current-status audit.
Costs, intensity and whether most advice was paid are unknown.
